content.snl: def(Type.constructorTargets(@C,@I),%after removing the leading dependent-product binders from C, the head of its result is I%)

values.en: For a constructor c : Π Δ, R, remove the leading constructor-argument telescope Δ. The head constant of R must be the newly declared inductive family I, possibly applied to its parameters and indices. Thus c constructs an I-object rather than an unrelated type.
values.zh-CN: 对于构造子 c : Π Δ, R，先去掉开头的构造参数望远镜 Δ。R 的头常量必须是新声明的归纳类型族 I，它可以应用于参数和指标。因而 c 确实构造 I 的对象，而不是无关类型。
